claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Chlorthalidone is a thiazide-like diuretic/carbonic anhydrase inhibitor that is not expected to kill cancer cells at 2.5 uM; any apparent antiproliferative effect would likely reflect nonspecific, weak growth inhibition rather than a bona fide cytotoxic mechanism.
